summary: Reviewed two user-uploaded Kyna English lesson PDFs. (1) 'Where did you grow up?' Speaking Practice (9 pages): produced a verified Vietnamese A1–A2 Markdown guide at /mnt/data/kyna_where_did_you_grow_up_speaking_notes.md (272 lines), covering all 20 original lesson questions with two English answer examples plus brief Vietnamese translation each, coherent fictional Hanoi/Alex and Da Lat/Linh narratives, source /d/-/t/ pronunciation activities, structures, 45–60 second monologues, exercises with answers, and 20-minute study plan. (2) Business English Beginner 1A 'Can you buy me some snacks?' (13 pages): produced /mnt/data/kyna_can_you_buy_me_some_snacks_study_notes.md (264 lines), includes all 10 source slide-3 units, partitive noun structures, polite requests (Can/Could, Would you mind), accepting/declining, slide-7 answers B/A/C and sample open-ended slide-10 responses, 10 extra role-play prompts each with two answers, two coherent fictional scenarios (overtime snacks and team-meeting groceries), two dialogues, error drills, and study plan. Source material and assistant additions marked distinctly. No private facts, transcripts, or secrets persisted.
